public_rationale: The financial-strain reading is checkable in principle, but the retrieved records do not establish the claimed ranking. Alphabet discloses substantial financial resources, and Anthropic describes expanding infrastructure arrangements. Neither supplies the missing matched comparison with OpenAI. Quarterly figures, fundraising announcements and individual compute deals cannot be combined into a reliable May ranking. The unspecified accounting basis also prevents a supported or contradicted money assessment.
limitations: The reporting month and interpretation of asset backing are evaluator choices.
Some private-company financial reporting could not be read and was excluded.
An unresolved assessment does not establish that the comparative claim was false.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Compared with the rival AI providers he named (Anthropic, Google, maybe Amazon), OpenAI is spending the most money with the fewest assets and has made the most commitments.
conditions: compared with rival providers named in the interview (Anthropic, Google, maybe Amazon)

statement.excerpt: They’re also spending most money with least assets. they’ve made the most commitments.
statement.document_title: Breaking news, and how the end might begin

from_speaker: spending most money with least assets
They do not have the deep pockets that Google does
our_interpretation: Read together with the discussion of cash burn and paying bills, the ordinary claim is that OpenAI's spending is most stretched relative to its asset backing, and that it has undertaken the largest financial commitments. Absolute quarterly expenditure alone would not test this reading.
Assets means resources available to support spending. Compare liquid resources and total assets separately; neither company valuation nor promised investment is automatically available cash.

Commitments means outstanding obligations to spend money, especially on computing infrastructure. Distinguish binding obligations from announced ambitions and avoid counting overlapping agreements twice.

Use May 2026, the latest completed month before publication, to interpret the ongoing state. Marcus supplies no reporting period; quarterly observations are context unless they establish the May position.
Include Anthropic and Google, with Amazon as the expressly tentative additional comparator. Parent-company resources matter where they are available to support the AI business.
The passage identifies no accounting basis or particular financial dataset. The contract therefore retains an unknown accounting basis.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records establish that OpenAI had the most strained relationship between cash spending and available assets among the named providers, alongside the largest outstanding spending commitments. The comparison must explain its treatment of asset backing, payment schedules and conditional commitments.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish that OpenAI did not have the greatest spending burden relative to asset backing, or that another named provider had larger outstanding commitments on the same basis. Larger absolute expenditure by Google or Amazon alone does not contradict the claim.
